verdict.rationale: Better Auth's first-party SSO plugin explicitly supports OIDC, OAuth2 providers, and SAML 2.0. The homepage markets enterprise SSO/SAML 2.0, and a community commenter independently notes its SAML/SSO capabilities. Okta, Entra, and Google Workspace are illustrative IdPs reachable over these standard protocols, but none is documented by name. missing for 10: provider-specific setup docs for Okta/Entra/Google Workspace, detail on SAML configuration depth (metadata, attribute mapping, IdP- vs SP-initiated flows), hands-on corroboration of workforce SSO deployments, and clarity on which SSO features are enterprise-only.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can connect enterprise identity providers over SAML and OIDC (Okta, Entra, Google Workspace) for workforce sign-in

citations.quote: This plugin supports OpenID Connect (OIDC), OAuth2 providers, and SAML 2.0.
